tools.name: create_secret_santa
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to draw names for a Secret Santa or holiday gift exchange and give each person a private link. Takes 3 to 60 names, optional couples or households who must not draw each other, one-way exclusions (for example last year's match), a budget, an exchange date and a note. Pub
